name: WWT Arundel Adventure Play Area
description: Gated adventure play area for pre-school and primary ages, with lily pad springs, walkways with balancing blocks, bird houses with a rope walk and slide, a scramble net and see-saws, on soft woodchip. Open 10am to 4.30pm.
fee: Non-members pay to visit; see the centre's tickets page for prices. WWT members get in free at all 10 wetland centres.
